## Review
I started knowing it was a comedy.  
I was mentally prepared to watch something light — but the problem was that neither the comedy nor the tension delivered.  

The story is predictable from start to finish.  
It leans entirely on familiar <mark>hero</mark> genre clichés, with no surprising or subversive moments.  
With a plot this foreseeable, the show should have made a choice: push hard with fast-paced action, or go all-in on the comedy.  
But this drama kept drifting somewhere in between, never finding its footing.  
```adcard
```
The comedic scenes had less punch than expected.  
The intent to be funny was clear, but moments that actually made you laugh were rare.  
Whenever the show shifted into a serious emotional beat, even the little energy it had seemed to drain away.  

The pacing drags.  
Despite only being 8 episodes, the tedium began to pile up past the midpoint, and as the finale approached it became clear this was an open ending designed with a Season 2 in mind rather than a real conclusion.  
Knowing there might be a Season 2 doesn't make it any easier to look forward to — not when this season already felt like too little.
